Enemies, dead or distant formations, unfinished or destroyed Halls are excluded; overlapping pulses retain the strongest active values rather than stacking.

The Expand rack presents Z XIII Hall and B XII Shift-Bell Foundry separately; the Hall changes formations while the Foundry continues advancing queues and construction.
